messages.text: Northbridge says NB54361-L is pin-compatible with NB54360 and it's ₹190 vs ₹250 at our volumes. Could we use it on PSM-28 Rev 2? That's a decent cost-down on every PDU-28 and BCU-24.

Pin-compatible yes, but the -L variant has a lower junction temperature rating. Our PDU-28 sits in sealed avionics enclosures with no forced air. I'll put it through the 70C ambient soak before we decide. Tracking in HW-311.

TR-112 is done. NB54361-L on PSM-28 Rev 2 went into thermal shutdown at 68C ambient under full load in the sealed enclosure. NB54360 held regulation through 70C with margin. Details on page 4 of the report.

Decision: we reject NB54361-L as a substitute for NB54360 on PSM-28 Rev 2 because it fails thermal derating at 70C ambient in sealed avionics enclosures (TR-112). Keep NB54360. Logging this as DEC-117. Revisit only with a part that passes the same soak.
Understood, I'll stop the NB54361-L quote follow-up with Deccan Components.
